map.10 项 ADL（进食、洗澡、修饰、穿衣、二便控制、如厕、床椅转移、行走、楼梯等: Ten ADL items (eating, bathing, grooming, dressing, bowel and bladder control, toileting, bed and chair transfer, walking, stairs and so on) are scored by degree of independence and summed, with a maximum of about 100. A higher score means more self-sufficiency, and it is a dependency measure used widely at home and abroad.
map.Barthel 指数怎么算到 0–100？: How is the Barthel index scored 0-100?
map.→ 打开护理（等级/评估/计划）制定工具: -> Open the nursing (level / assessment / plan) design tool
map.按 Barthel 指数（ADL）、认知与年龄等维度评估老年人护理等级，输出等级: Assesses the nursing level of older people across dimensions such as the Barthel index (ADL), cognition and age, and outputs a level with care plan essentials, for reference in eldercare institution assessment.
map.本工具在 Barthel 基础上叠加认知(cog)：高分且认知正常判自理；认知下: This tool layers cognition (cog) on top of the Barthel index: a high score with normal cognition is judged self-sufficient; cognitive decline raises the dependency level and adjusts the care plan (for example strengthening measures against wandering and adding medication reminders).
map.社区与机构据此匹配巡访频次、照护强度与康复计划。: Communities and institutions use this to match visit frequency, care intensity and rehabilitation plans.
map.算例：Barthel=50、认知轻度下降(cog=1): Worked example: Barthel = 50, mild cognitive decline (cog = 1)
map.认知状态如何影响等级？: How does cognitive status affect the level?
map.评分越高生活越自理；认知下降会叠加依赖等级，需综合判断。: A higher score means more self-sufficient living; cognitive decline adds a dependency level on top, so judgement must be combined.
map.长期照护等级评定中，用 Barthel 指数（10 项 ADL）结合认知状态划分: In long-term care level assessment, the Barthel index (10 ADL items) is combined with cognitive status to grade from self-sufficient to heavily dependent.
map.：Barthel≥40 且 <60 → 『二级（中度依赖）』，需每日探访、协助生: : Barthel >= 40 and < 60 gives "level 2 (moderate dependence)", requiring daily visits, help with daily living and rehabilitation training; if cognition scores 2 or above, add the note about cognitive impairment.
map.：Barthel≥80 且认知正常 → 『四级（自理）』，建议每周探访 1 次、: : Barthel >= 80 with normal cognition gives "level 4 (self-sufficient)", with one visit a week, health guidance and social activities recommended.
